querySpecs.query: Task: PREFERRED_LODGING_PARTNERSHIP_VENUE_DISCOVERY | Find businesses and venues near the hotel (verified hotel address, the hotel market) that could refer hotel guestrooms or groups — weddings, private celebrations, banquets, cultural/private functions, clubs, museums, entertainment destinations, and complementary event facilities. | A competing event venue can be a valuable Preferred Lodging partner when it has no guestrooms or only complementary / overflow lodging need. | Do NOT reject a venue merely because it offers meeting space, banquet halls, or catering — those often create overnight guest referral demand for a nearby hotel. | Prefer venues without a full competing guestroom inventory; still assess limited on-site lodging for overflow partnership potential (use UNKNOWN when not evidenced). | Exclude generic restaurants unless a documented event format credibly creates overnight visitors. | Return venue name, address, website, event types, on-site lodging status if published, and any lodging-partner language. | Do not invent distances, drive times, annual wedding counts, or room-night forecasts. | Venue types: wedding_reception_venue, standalone_banquet_hall, private_event_facility, independent_conference_event_venue, museum_event_rental, garden_or_historic_property, country_club_or_private_club_outside_events, cultural_institution_event_space, entertainment_destination_event_venue, waterfront_or_rooftop_event_venue

segmentCoverage.note: FULL_COVERAGE requires live discovery evaluation for every planned segment with no deep-cap truncation and no synthetic corpus evidence.

honestyNotes: Cheaper runs are not better unless coverage and commercial quality are also considered.
Zero-yield research is reported explicitly when selected/actionable/live-new are empty.
Economics do not invent incremental quality from drawer length.
verifiedCommercialContactsGained counts named primaryContactName / salesReadyContacts on processed rows — not Sales Ready and not verified personal email.
opportunitiesBecomingActionable excludes final EXCLUDE disposition even when commercialResearchComplete is true.
canonicalSalesReadyCount is the only economics field that reflects Sales Ready eligibility.
Portfolio certification must prefer commercialEligibilityStatus + reconciled disposition over intermediate economics counters.

fullE2eCompleteClaimBlockedReason: Fixture/zero-cost chain proves module connectivity — live Exa Full E2E requires authorized budget

pricingAssumptions.note: Exa Agent fixed-effort list prices; auto/max require separate ceilings. $0.10/run is not guaranteed for all operations.

budgetManifest.note: One bounded Full E2E authorization requested — not per-segment micro-approvals. Paid execution must not start until founder authorizes this ceiling.

mutationGuard.note: Canonical Full E2E may dry-run map and plan writes; live Airtable mutations require separate founder approval.

readBackContract.rule: API 200 alone is insufficient; identity field must read back equal to planned identityKey before CREATED/UPDATED is certified.
